findings.motion: SB 7 passed on third reading (Record 848), 78 yeas, 64 nays
findings.note: Voted nay on House passage of SB 7 (2021 regular session), a bill described in its caption as relating to election integrity and security, with new criminal offenses; the House text includes a section on the form of identification presented.

findings.passage: When Record No. 118 was taken, I was absent. I would have voted no.
findings.note: Statement of vote printed in the House Journal after she was absent when the House adopted the conference committee report on SB 1 (second called session, 2021), a bill on election integrity and security that also covers ID numbers on mail ballot applications and envelopes. She states how she would have voted.
